page_title: ANG 4-2 ETI | Angers v St Etienne 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' 4 - 2 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Bamba Dieng (Angers) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 4:2.
90+2' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jim Allevinah walks off the pitch to be replaced by Esteban Lepaul (Angers).
90+1' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) causes Yahia Fofana little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

89' Angers slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
86' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
86' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) will take a corner kick.
85' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
84' Himad Abdelli will be replaced by Bamba Dieng (Angers).
84' Carlens Arcus (Angers) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
81' Good movement by Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
80' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
78' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to substitute Lucas Stassin and he is replaced by Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne).
77' A substitution has been made. Farid El Melali is replaced by Haris Belkebla (Angers).
76' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) serves up a nice cross, but Yahia Fofana punches the ball away.

73' Farid El Melali (Angers) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
71' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
69' 3 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ibrahima Niane (Angers) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Gautier Larsonneur no chance!
69' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) is going to take the penalty!

68' Referee Marc Bollengier sees the trip by Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Angers are awarded a penalty.
67' St Etienne are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
65' The game has come to an end for Augustine Boakye. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mathis Amougou (St Etienne).
65' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) replacing Benjamin Bouchouari.
65' Here's the change. Louis Mouton leaves the pitch and Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) comes on as a substitute.

64' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
62' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
60' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Himad Abdelli (Angers) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
59' Farid El Melali (Angers) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
57' 2 - 2 Goal! Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is teed up on the edge of the box by Lucas Stassin, and his howitzer of a shot inside the right post gives the keeper no chance. 2:2.
55' Farid El Melali (Angers) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
55' Himad Abdelli (Angers) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Angers force their opponents to concede a corner.
52' Yahia Fofana had to pull off an exquisite save to thwart a knuckleball from Louis Mouton (St Etienne), even though it only went towards the middle of the target.
51' Florent Hanin (Angers) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
49' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
48' Florent Hanin (Angers) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The linesman signals a throw-in for St Etienne.
47' Florent Hanin (Angers) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
46' Olivier Dall'Oglio prepares a substitution. Yunis Abdelhamid is replaced by Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne).
46' Substitution. Yassine Belkhdim is replaced by Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+10' The match has reached half-time.
45+8' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes a short corner kick.
45+8' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the middle of the net, but Yahia Fofana makes a decent save to stop the effort.
45+7' A pass from Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) is intercepted by Yahia Fofana and the move breaks down.

45+4' Jim Allevinah (Angers) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
44' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
39' 2 - 1 Goal! Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
38' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) for his blatant foul.

38' Jim Allevinah (Angers) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant low shot to the middle of the goal, but is thwarted by a decent save from Gautier Larsonneur.
35' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes a long run up and smashes the free kick at goal, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
34' A yellow-coloured card is received by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Angers, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marc Bollengier didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
26' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
25' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
24' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
22' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
21' Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
19' Wonderful movement by St Etienne. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
16' Goal! Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yahia Fofana into the bottom right corner.
14' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
14' Wait! The referee has seen an infringement and St Etienne will have to take the penalty again!
13' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) misses the penalty. He fired the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulled off a tremendous diving save to deny him.
13' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
12' Jordan Lefort (Angers) makes a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from St Etienne is about to take a penalty kick.

10' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Himad Abdelli (Angers) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
6' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) is penalised for a foul. Marc Bollengier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
4' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Ibrahima Niane (Angers), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
2' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. St Etienne will take a throw-in.
1' 1 - 1 It's a goal! The author of the penalty kick is Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne).
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. St Etienne will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will supervise the game today.
